annotations.title: Find businesses by need and place

description: Find businesses that sell what the customer needs in the place they name, for example need "espresso beans" and place "Montreal", or need "plumber" and place "H2X". Both are required. Searches businesses published on Orbylon whose owners proved they own their website, by the words of what they sell and the place they named. Results are ordered by how closely those words match, then by name. No business pays to rank higher, and a business that is not on Orbylon is not here. Each result gives the business's name, city, address, hours and phone as its owner confirmed them, what it sells with exact prices, and which tool to use next: place_order for a priced item, request_quote for an item priced on request, list_business_offerings for the full list. At most 10 results. To try it on Orbylon's fictional test businesses, use the place "Orbylon Test City".

need.description: What the customer needs, in a few words: a product, a service or a kind of business

place.description: Where: a city, a region or a postal code, e.g. Montreal, Laval, QC or H2X 1Y4
